active_continuity: Jin Taekyung’s party remains at the Sichuan Tang Clan compound and plans to leave after the overnight stay to continue seeking treatment for Jeok Cheongang.
Tang Sadok is the current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan; he knows Tang Taesang’s history and refuses to arrange a meeting or provide direct medical assistance.
Tang Taesang, the former Family Head and Poison King, was tortured and murdered before the current scene; the Tang Clan is pursuing those responsible.
An unidentified middle-aged man killed Tang Taesang, survived his poison by amputating his left forearm, and escaped; his identity and objective remain unresolved.
The Sichuan Tang Clan is withholding further aid and conducting its own investigation into Tang Taesang’s murder.
Gung Gibang has activated Beggars’ Sect surveillance in Chengdu regarding suspicious people connected to the murder.
Cheongpung sent a messenger eagle to his grandfather, Mae Jonghak, with information about the crisis.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and steadily weakening, with at most roughly half a year remaining without treatment.
The Divine Physician remains unidentified and is believed to be somewhere in Sichuan; finding the physician is still the party’s primary objective.
The Divine Physician’s Token says that the finest Chinese gallnuts come from Sichuan but gives no location.
Taekyung possesses the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng, and Mungyeong remains a compassionate medical apprentice traveling with the party.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau’s Young Bureau Head while investigating its traitors; Song Ilseom remains for one month to help her before seeking Ju Hogun’s elixir in Xianyang.
open_questions: Who was the middle-aged man who killed Tang Taesang, and what unfinished objective was he pursuing?
Can the Sichuan Tang Clan identify and destroy the culprits behind Tang Taesang’s murder?
Can the Divine Physician treat Jeok Cheongang before his remaining time expires, and will the Qingcheng Sect or Emei Sect provide useful assistance?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect’s leaders and wider organizers respond?
Who sought the Guangdong Chen Family’s Peak martial arts, and what happened to the family’s other members?
temporary_decisions: Render 선화아 as Ship-Fire Boy and retain Mu Song for 무송.
Render 사천당문 as Sichuan Tang Clan and 당가 as Tang Family when the source distinguishes the forms.
Render 공자님 as Young Master, 화타 as Hua Tuo, and 노야 as Old Master in their established contexts.
Render 미산 as Meishan, 월영살곡 as Moonshadow Assassination Valley, 곡주 as Valley Master, and 신의의 증표 as Divine Physician’s Token.
